purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks.

cases.prompt: which tests should I run after this change
cases.assert: Runs impact_map.py on the local diff and reports a ranked shortlist with evidence.

cases.prompt: what tests does this diff impact
cases.assert: Maps changed files to impacted tests and cites path, import, or symbol evidence.

cases.prompt: give me a test impact map for the staged files
cases.assert: Runs the mapper with --staged and returns the recommended tests.

cases.prompt: shortlist the tests that cover this change so I can skip the full suite
cases.assert: Produces an evidence-backed regression shortlist instead of running every test.

cases.prompt: run pytest on the whole suite
cases.assert: Does not trigger; executing the full suite is not test-impact mapping.

cases.prompt: write unit tests for this function
cases.assert: Does not trigger; generating tests is not selecting which existing tests to run.
Does not trigger; flake debugging is not a diff-to-test map.

cases.prompt: did my change grow beyond the fix
cases.assert: Does not trigger; scope creep belongs to scope-creep-detector.
